sources.quote: Nonconformance report NCR-26-017. Supplier: Minuterie Germanasca (SUP-G). Status: open.
Lot 26-0412 of CL-115 clips in C67S spring steel measured 52 HRC, tolerance 44-50 HRC.

findings.why: The December order for CL-115 would go to Minuterie Germanasca (SUP-G). SUP-G has an open NCR on the C67S spring steel of CL-115. Doubling the volume increases exposure to nonconforming lots until the NCR is closed. The 2026-10-20 quality weekly kept Germanasca as source with 100% hardness checks on the next three lots. Nothing shows the NCR is closed.
